title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23388v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repet

translated_title: QDA：基于智能体的闭环大语言模型量化设计
translated_abstract: 训练后量化是以低成本部署大语言模型的标准方式。然而，最佳量化方案因模型和精度而异。因此，专家必须为每个新模型重新设计方案，这既耗时又往往不是最优的。幸运的是，大语言模型智能体可以通过在多轮构建和评估候选方案的过程中不断改进量化方案来接管这一设计工作，使得评估轮数越多，方案质量越高。然而，评估一个量化推理模型需要数十个GPU小时，而且要结合来自不同代码库的方法，就需要手动将每个方法移植到新架构上。我们提出了QDA，一个由智能体为每个模型和精度设计量化方案的系统。为了加快评估速度，QDA通过计算每个候选方案在智能体从未见过的推理轨迹上与原始模型输出的KL散度，在几分钟内完成评分，并对有前景的候选方案进行长文本生成检查，以捕捉重复等失败情况……
tldr: QDA提出了一个基于智能体的闭环系统，通过KL散度快速评估候选量化方案并自动化整合不同代码库的方法，为每个模型和精度自动设计最优的大语言模型训练后量化方案。
en_tdlr: QDA presents a closed-loop agent system that automatically designs optimal post-training quantization recipes for each model and precision by rapidly scoring candidates via KL divergence and automating the integration of methods across different codebases.
